notes.title: Update to version 1.4
notes.notes:
Increased contrast

Added "dragging dots" by holding right-click and dragging over the field

Added ghost marker. Toggle placing ghosts by pressing the ghost button or by holding shift

Added undo history

notes.title: Update to version 1.3
notes.notes:
Added settings
- Audio Volume
- Hide Timer
- Disable Background Animation

Redesigned splash screen

Animated background

Added a menu button to the in-game scene

Added undo and redo

Autosave when exiting the game
